name: Youjian Chuiyan Inn
aiSummary: Review summary Powered by AI Location:Centrally situated near popular attractions , with easy access to hiking trails and local restaurants.(based on 4 reviews) Amenities:Spacious courtyard with a large pool, playground , outdoor seating , and barbecue facilities.(based on 4 reviews) Cleanliness:Rooms and bathrooms were consistently described as clean, with well-stocked toiletries and fresh bedding.(based on 12 reviews) Service:Hosts were praised for their warmth, hospitality, and willingness to assist with travel arrangements .(based on 6 reviews) Facilities:Multi-story buildings with ample rooms, private balconies, and family-friendly features .(based on 5 reviews) Value:Competitive pricing for the included amenities , with some reviews noting affordability despite large group accommodations.(based on 3 reviews)

topics.text: Centrally situated near popular attractions , with easy access to hiking trails and local restaurants.
Spacious courtyard with a large pool, playground , outdoor seating , and barbecue facilities.
Rooms and bathrooms were consistently described as clean, with well-stocked toiletries and fresh bedding.
Hosts were praised for their warmth, hospitality, and willingness to assist with travel arrangements .

comments.quote: 大床房的面積更大一些，住的更舒服。小院環境非常好，面積很大，山水田園，詩情畫意，如痴如醉，房間設施略顯簡陋，但乾淨整潔。民宿離碧塢龍潭景區很近，步行15分鐘左右，開車5分鐘就到了。周圍還有仙潭村景區和魚鱗壩景區，非常方便，期待下次再來！
comments.author: Jinlinghuaisong

comments.quote: 太喜歡這家民宿了。雖然周邊一路上都是各種民宿 ，但是還是最愛這家。性價比超高 ，有一個夢中的小院子，停車很方便，院子裏面有滑滑梯 大泳池 天幕 ，還有楊梅樹，桃樹，都結了果子，等到暑假真的還想再來一次，多住幾天，還有早餐吃，老闆娘人也很熱情，很淳樸，房間很乾凈，陽光充足。非常開心的入住，可惜衹住了短暫的一天
comments.author: Guest User
